title: Half-screen overlays

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Balance image and explanation so viewers can follow the subject while reading supporting information.
strategic_value: A consistent half-screen panel can let Helsinki explain footage without replacing it entirely.
demonstration: This expanded webpage-section capture shows left and right half-screen color panels, including centered text, a wave edge and an inset panel with a margin.
practical_value: Choose a full-height or inset half-screen panel and apply the corresponding edge rule.

content_islands.name: Panel conditions
content_islands.spec: Keep the positioning and wave-edge conditions together at the top.

content_islands.name: Four compositions
content_islands.spec: Stack left and right panels, including a right wave-edged panel and an inset right panel, with their captions.

ingredient.name: Half-screen text panel
ingredient.role: Allow image and explanation to share the frame.
ingredient.application: Use centered or upper-left text on a left or right panel. A full panel may have a wave edge; an inset title-safe panel must not.
ingredient.scope: Half-screen overlays; the examples use 100 px text and 120 px leading. The source’s introductory sentence says full-screen despite this section’s half-screen title.

reference_purposes.Application: The specimens compare left, right and inset half-screen panels.
reference_purposes.Constraint: When a title-safe margin surrounds the color background, wave motifs must not be used on its edge.
reference_purposes.Expression: Green and orange panels divide the photographic scenes.
